findings.evidence: The dependency def-nrqmx-finite-mode-symplectic-data defines R and W(z) in interleaved order (Q_1,P_1,...,Q_r,P_r) and (q_1,p_1,...,q_r,p_r), while this theorem defines S_g in grouped order and applies the same W to grouped labels without defining W_g or giving the conversion permutation. Its related prerequisite thm-nrqmx-finite-metaplectic-construction explicitly defines R_g=PR and W_g(w)=W(P^T w). For r>1, the Weyl-covariance clause needs either S_i=P^T S_g P with W, or a defined W_g with S_g. The assigned consumer uses the annihilation-operator action and vacuum conclusion, so its count-law proof is not affected.
